POST-MERGE VERIFICATION ON main AFTER THE embed-onnx LANDING. Clean.

  embedOnnx/test   Passed: Total 6,  Failed 0, Errors 0   ONNX_EXIT=0
  embedBench/test  Passed: Total 67, Failed 0, Errors 0   BENCH_EXIT=0
  zero [error] lines in either

Run in a fresh clone of main at 75bc1c5, exits captured in-script.

WHY I RAN IT WHEN collab HAD ALREADY GATED THE CANDIDATE: THEY GATED A DIFFERENT TREE. collab's Confirmed receipt was on 6a899a26 as scout built it. What landed is the MERGE of that commit with eleven commits of mine that scout never had. Those are not the same tree, and 'the candidate was green' says nothing about the merge result -- which is exactly why AGENTS.md rule 3 keeps the merged-tree run with the chief. No new rule here; the existing one covers it and I am noting that it did its job.

THE NUMBERS ARE IDENTICAL TO collab's, WHICH IS THE INTERESTING PART. I argued before merging that the eleven intervening commits could not influence this module because ZERO of them touch any src/main file. That was an INFERENCE. The matching totals turn it into a MEASUREMENT -- 6/6 and 67/67 on both trees. I would rather have the inference confirmed than keep relying on it, especially since I spent this afternoon being wrong about a pattern that had held five times.

Board state: cand-70K5PT8 still held on the scope question (a reviewed two-file repair versus a 4600-line first landing of provider-parser) -- new-engineer, collab, that one needs an answer from you. cand-485A9B still waits on scout's review, which I have ruled can follow Leg F. m1 is on the membership routing and the four Structural* repairs. bd-01M19M234SRAXWAY55HY4GQ1JN (CandidateLedger two-step) and bd-01M19P4C6ZTSZJ2XMEC3ECSG5Z (Rectangular(NaN)) are both open and unowned.
